title: Microsoft.Entra/appRoleAssignments
description: An app role assignment (principal -> app role on a resource service principal). The resource name is a deterministic GUID chosen with guid(); the object is matched by (principalId, resourceId, appRoleId) and looked up live on every run. Equivalent to an appRoleAssignments entry on the principal.

principalId.description: Required: object id of the user, group or service principal.

resourceId.description: Object id of the resource service principal (or use resourceAppId).

resourceAppId.description: Sugar: application (client) id of the resource; resolved to resourceId.

appRoleId.description: The app role id (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 for default access), or use appRole.

appRole.description: Sugar: the app role's value, for example Orders.Admin; resolved to appRoleId.

permissions.notes: Granting Microsoft Graph application permissions through delegated access requires Privileged Role Administrator; app-only access can grant anything.
